title: Skald Game System Configuration
description: Configuration schema for game system registration

name.description: Display name of the game system

category.description: System category for grouping (e.g., pbta, neo-classic, fate)

defaultGenre.description: Genre theme a table of this system starts with (omit for neutral)

schema.description: Path to schema.json relative to system directory

template.description: Path to template.json relative to system directory

defaultData.description: Path to default-data.json relative to system directory

sheetComponent.description: Character sheet component to use. If not specified, uses generic renderer.

wizard.description: Path to the Character Creation Wizard (skald/wizard/v1) the built-in template publishes; omit for none

lookupTables.description: Path to lookup tables JSON file

rollRules.description: Path to roll rules JSON file

aliases.description: Path to attribute aliases JSON file

rollMacros.description: Path to roll macros JSON file
